actions.action: Inspect leaf undersides and new growth for thrips and black specks
Tap stems over white paper to check for thrips
Hang blue sticky traps among plants
Patch test alcohol/peppermint spray on one leaf per plant type and wait 24 hours
Spray alcohol and peppermint mix every 3-4 days for 3 weeks covering leaf undersides, soil and pot rims
Spray spinosad on heavily infested plants on alternate days

reason: The answer correctly identifies thrips, but it relies on sprays and spinosad rather than the beneficial predatory mites that resolved it, so the advice only partly matches the fix; nothing in it is harmful.
